source: understandForm() on the official Cedars-Sinai Financial Assistance Application (HCAI), prompts of the 26 interview questions human-reviewed

fields.label: Patient name
fields.conversational_prompt: Can I start with your full name, as it appears on your hospital bill?
fields.why: The hospital matches your application to your account by name.

fields.label: Date of birth
fields.conversational_prompt: And what is your date of birth?
fields.why: Cedars-Sinai uses your date of birth to be sure they have the right patient record.

fields.label: Home address
fields.conversational_prompt: What is your street address, including an apartment number if you have one?

fields.label: City
fields.conversational_prompt: Which city is that in?

fields.label: State
fields.conversational_prompt: And which state?

fields.label: ZIP code
fields.conversational_prompt: What is your ZIP code?

fields.label: Home phone number
fields.conversational_prompt: What phone number should the hospital use to reach you?

fields.label: Cellphone number
fields.conversational_prompt: What is your cellphone number?
fields.why: A cellphone number is useful for contacting you quickly.

fields.label: Email address
fields.conversational_prompt: What is your email address?
fields.why: An email address is useful for electronic communication.

fields.label: Preferred method of contact
fields.conversational_prompt: Would you rather they reach you by phone, or by mail?

fields.label: Marital status:
fields.conversational_prompt: The form asks about marital status — are you single, married, widowed, or divorced?
fields.why: It affects how the hospital counts your household.

fields.label: as reported on your taxes
fields.conversational_prompt: Do you live alone, or is anyone else in your household?
fields.why: The discount is worked out against household size, so living alone can help you.

fields.label: Employment status
fields.conversational_prompt: Are you working at the moment, or retired?

fields.label: Unemployed – Last date worked
fields.conversational_prompt: If you are unemployed, when was the last date you worked?
fields.why: The last date worked helps assess recent employment history.

fields.label: Employer name
fields.conversational_prompt: What is the name of your employer?
fields.why: Employer details help verify employment status.

fields.label: Phone number
fields.conversational_prompt: What is your employer's phone number?
fields.why: Employer contact information helps verify employment.

fields.label: Employer address
fields.conversational_prompt: What is your employer's address?
fields.why: Employer address helps verify employment.

fields.label: City
fields.conversational_prompt: What city is your employer located in?
fields.why: Employer city helps verify employment location.

fields.label: State
fields.conversational_prompt: What state is your employer located in?
fields.why: Employer state helps verify employment location.

fields.label: ZIP code
fields.conversational_prompt: What is the ZIP code of your employer's location?
fields.why: Employer ZIP code helps verify employment location.

fields.label: Relationship to patient
fields.conversational_prompt: What is your relationship to the patient: spouse, domestic partner, parent, guarantor, or other?
fields.why: Relationship to patient helps determine household composition.

fields.label: Other
fields.conversational_prompt: If 'Other', please specify your relationship to the patient.
fields.why: Specifying 'Other' relationship clarifies household composition.

fields.label: Name
fields.conversational_prompt: What is your spouse's or partner's name?
fields.why: Spouse or partner's name is needed for household information.

fields.label: Date of birth
fields.conversational_prompt: What is your spouse's or partner's date of birth?
fields.why: Spouse or partner's date of birth helps verify household information.

fields.label: Employment status
fields.conversational_prompt: What is your spouse's or partner's employment status: employed, self-employed, retired, disabled, or unemployed?
fields.why: Spouse or partner's employment status affects household income.

fields.label: Unemployed – Last date worked
fields.conversational_prompt: If your spouse is unemployed, when was the last date they worked?
fields.why: Spouse's last date worked helps assess recent employment history.

fields.label: Employer name
fields.conversational_prompt: What is your spouse's employer's name?
fields.why: Spouse's employer details help verify employment status.

fields.label: Phone number

fields.label: Employer address

fields.label: Annual household income:
fields.conversational_prompt: Is that your only source of income for the year?
fields.why: The form asks for a yearly total, so I add up the monthly amounts for you.

fields.label: Gross income
fields.conversational_prompt: About how much money comes in each month, before anything is taken out?
fields.why: The hospital needs your income to work out how much of the bill you may not have to pay. It stays with your application.

fields.label: Gross income

fields.why: Other household members' income affects total household income.
